subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this issue be resolved as docs/help completion for the existing pi-tui newline support, or should OpenClaw add a public configurable TUI send/newline keybinding surface?
rationale: The raw newline behavior already exists through pi-tui, but adding Enter/Ctrl+Enter preferences would create a new public config or CLI contract that repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Document current behavior first
options.body: Add docs and /help for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and fallback behavior while deferring configurable keybindings until a separate approved contract exists.

options.title: Approve configurable keybindings
options.body: Add a narrow TUI keybinding preference or CLI/config bridge with tests for default Enter-to-send and opt-in alternate send behavior.

options.title: Close as implemented
options.body: Treat the dependency-backed Shift+Enter support as sufficient and leave configurable keybindings to future separate requests.

recommendation.title: Document current behavior first
recommendation.body: Add docs and /help for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and fallback behavior while deferring configurable keybindings until a separate approved contract exists.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest routing signal from the prior issue review and recent TUI/docs history.
